out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at the bar handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC REPLACED PAPER TOWELS.

out_items.name: Food-contact surfaces cleaned and sanitized

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: Observed the concentration of chlorine in the bar chemical dish machine at 0ppm
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. PIC SET UP 3 COMPARTMENT SINK.

violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean per Manufacturer
violations.observation: Surfaces of ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment are not being cleaned as required. OBSERVED BUILD UP ON THE INSIDE OF THE ICE MACHINE.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food such as ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment such as ice makers, cooking oil storage tanks and distribution lines, beverage and syrup dispensing lines or tubes, coffee bean grinders, and water vending equipment at a frequency specified by the manufacturer or at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold.

out_items.name: Certified Food Protection Manager

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. NO CFM WAS PRESENT AT THE TIME OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CFM ARRIVED BEFORE THE END OF THE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. EHS PROVIDED DOCUMENT.

out_items.name: Food-contact surfaces cleaned and sanitized

violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean per Manufacturer
violations.observation: Surfaces of ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment are not being cleaned as required. OBSERVED THAT THE INTERIOR OF THE ICE MACHINE IS IN NEED OF CLEANING.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food such as ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment such as ice makers, cooking oil storage tanks and distribution lines, beverage and syrup dispensing lines or tubes, coffee bean grinders, and water vending equipment at a frequency specified by the manufacturer or at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold.

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Upon discussion with the person-in-charge, no signed Employee Illness Reporting Agreement forms were provided during the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information emailed at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. EHS EMAILED EMPLOYEE ILLNESS REPORTING POLICIES TO MANAGEMENT FOR SIGNATURE AND REVIEW DURING THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: Open drinking containers and employee food observed in the kitchen on the work surface.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may have beverages in the kitchen areas as long as they are covered and consumed through a straw and stored in a manner that will prevent contamination to food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER THAT EMPLOYEE’S SHALL ONLY CONSUME FOOD IN THE DINING AREA OR OFFICE SPACE. DRINKS MAY BE ALLOWED IN THE KITCHEN AREAS IF THE CUPS ARE COVERED AND THERE IS MINIMAL HAND TO MOUTH CONTACT. IT IS PREFERRED THAT THE BEVERAGES ARE CONSUMED THROUGH A STRAW BUT FLIP TOP TYPE LIDS ARE ALLOWED. ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Hands clean and properly washed

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee failed to wash his or her hands before engaging in food preparation after changing tasks multiple times.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. EHS INSTRUCTED THE STAFF MEMBER TO CHANGE HER GLOVES AND WASH HER HANDS AT THE HAND SINK CORRECTLY. ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at the KITCHEN and BAR handwashing sinks used by food employees.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO PROVIDE HAND WASHING SIGNS BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: 1) RAW STEAK IS STORED ON A SHELF ABOVE COOKED MEATS INSIDE THE 2DOOR PREP UNIT, 2) RAW SHELLED EGGS ARE STORED ON A SHELF ABOVE PRE- COOKED FOODS INSIDE THE 2DOOR UPRIGHT REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EHS DISCUSSED PROPER STORAGE OF RAW ANIMAL PROTEINS. MANAGER HAD STAFF MEMBER MOVE THE RAW ANIMAL FOODS TO THE BOTTOM SHELVES. ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP. CUE CLUB CAFE (Inspection Date: 12/12/2024) Page 2 of 4

out_items.name: Proper hot holding temperatures

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) CHICKEN WINGS WERE OBSERVED AT 113F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. EHS DISCUSSED THAT THE CHICKEN WINGS NEED TO BE MAINTAINED AT 135F OR ABOVE AT ALL TIMES OR BE COOKED AND IMMEDIATELY SERVED OR BE PLACED ON “TIME AS A PUBLIC HEALTH CONTROL.” STAFF PREFER TO USE “TIME.” SEE EMAILED AGREEMENT FORM FOR USING “TIME.” ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Food properly labeled, original container

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: 1) WORKING CONTAINERS AND BOTTLES OF SAUCES, DRY SEASONINGS, ETC.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. EHS DISCUSSED LABELING WORKING CONTAINERS, BULK BINS, AND/OR BOTTLES BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Insect Control Devices, Installation
violations.observation: Insect control device is located in an area right above the food prep area in the kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Relocate the insect control device so that it is not located over a food preparation area and dead insects are prevented from being falling on exposed food, clean equipment, utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service and single-use articles. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO MOVE THE BUG LIGHT BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Observed food, beverages, oil, etc directly stored on the floor in the bar areas, kitchen area, and hallway.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO PROVIDE NSF APPROVED SHELVING UNITS OR DUNNAGE RACKS SO THAT ALL ITEMS ARE 6 INCHES OFF THE FLOOR. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wipings Clothes Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO STORE WET TOWELS IN A CONTAINER OF A SANITIZING SOLUTION SUCH AS QUATERNARY AMMONIA AT 200-400PPM. ONLY CLEAN, DRY TOWELS MAY BE SITTING ON WORK SURFACES. ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: Observed the following in poor repair: 1) BATTERY NEEDED FOR THE DIGITAL FOOD THERMOMETER, 2) 3-VAT SINK DRAINS DO NOT CLOSE PROPERLY TO HOLD WATER IN THE BASINS.
violations.corrective_action: EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO GET A NEW BATTERY FOR THE FOOD THERMOMETER AND TO CALIBRATE IT ROUTINELY IN AN ICE WATER BATH TO 32F. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO GET THE DRAINS REPAIRED AT THE 3-VAT SINK SO THEY SEAL CORRECTLY AND HOLD WATER FOR PROPER WASHING, RINSING, AND SANITIZING OF EQUIPMENT AND UTENSILS. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Corrosion-Resistant/Nonabsorbent Materials
violations.observation: Observed grocery store plastic bags used for food storage inside refrigerators and freezers.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be durable, corrosion-resistant, and nonabsorbent. EHS DISCUSSED WITH THE MANAGER REMOVING ALL PLASTIC GROCERY STORE BAGS AND REPLACING WITH PROPER FOOD GRADE BAGS. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP. CUE CLUB CAFE (Inspection Date: 12/12/2024) Page 3 of 4

out_items.name: Plumbing installed, proper backflow devices

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the WATER FILTER SERVICING THE ICE MACHINE.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. EHS HAD THE MANAGER CALL FOR A LICENSED PLUMBER TO ORDER AND INSTALL A BACK FLOW PREVENTION DEVICE ON THE WATER LINE. THE DEVICE WAS ORDERED. THE DEVICE IS USUALLY SOME TYPE OF DUAL CHECK VALVE THAT HAS AN ASSE MODEL NUMBER. ENSURE THE PART IS INSTALLED BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Sewage and waste water properly disposed

violations.title: Grease Trap, Location for Easy Access
violations.observation: The grease trap is not easily accessible.
violations.corrective_action: If used, a grease trap shall be located to be easily accessible for cleaning. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO MOVE THE ITEMS AND CARTS STORED DIRECTLY ON TOP OF THE GREASE TRAP BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Toilet facilities properly constructed, supplied, and cleaned

violations.title: Toilet Rooms Enclosed
violations.observation: Observed both the men’s and ladies restroom doors not self-closing.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a self-closing hinge or closing mechanism for the toilet room door. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO INSTALL SELF CLOSING DOOR HINGES BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Dressing Rooms/Lockers, Designated
violations.observation: Employees are not using a designated area for storage of personal items like food, purses, jackets, coats, back packs, etc.
violations.corrective_action: Instruct employees to use a designated area to prevent contamination of food, food equipment and utensils, and preparation surfaces. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO DESIGNATE ONE AREA BELOW AND SEPARATED FROM FOOD, EQUIPMENT, UTENSILS, CLEAN LINENS, AND SINGLE SERVICE ITEMS USED FOR THE CUSTOMERS. ENSURE DESIGNATION AND CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

violations.title: Protective Shielding on Light Bulbs
violations.observation: Observed light bulbs in the dry storage area not shielded.
violations.corrective_action: Provide proper shielding on the light bulbs before the follow up inspection.
